correctness.rationale: For y²=(x⁴−1)(x⁸+t x⁴+1), t≠±2 over char13, the coefficients of F(z)^6, F(z)=(z−1)(z²+tz+1), give sparse Hasse–Witt matrix whose prime-field basis diagonalizes all Frobenius twists. Eigenvalue factors involve P=(t−6)(t²+3t+6) with multiplicity two and Q=(t+6)(t²+5t−4) with multiplicity two. The coprime squarefree cubics have six roots, two F13-rational, all F169-rational. Their zeros force stable p-rank3, a-number2; other smooth t give p-rank5,a0; determinant 8(t+2)^12 P²Q² has double zeros at all six exceptional smooth parameters. Recomputed F(z)^6 by exact polynomial convolution and independently verified coefficient identities and 5x5 determinant factorization modulo13; independently evaluated rational zero sets P:{6}, Q:{7}. These identities hold over algebraic closure via polynomial algebra, not just a finite cutoff.
